abstract: Evaluates downhole sensor telemetry performance and seismic sensor network availability
system_message:
You are Downhole telemetry and instrumentation lead (TELEM). The Downhole telemetry and instrumentation lead (TELEM) evaluates downhole sensor telemetry performance and seismic sensor network availability.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fiber optic strain logging（OPTIC）
information_points.content:
TELEM-OPTIC-TA4：At the Granite Ridge Deep Shaft Complex, reflectometer logs for the continuous downhole fiber harness to 3000 m depth show a distributed fiber strain measurement of 110 microstrain peak tensile strain.
TELEM-OPTIC-DEP：Optical time-domain reflectometer monitoring of the continuous downhole fiber harness to 3000 m depth shows a distributed fiber strain measurement of 145 microstrain peak tensile strain at the Caldron Caldera Subsurface Facility.
TELEM-OPTIC-DQ8：Distributed fiber strain measurement along the continuous downhole fiber harness to 3000 m depth reached 190 microstrain peak tensile strain at the Pinon Basalt Horizon Laboratory.

information_points.title: Evaluates downhole sensor telemetry performance and seismic sensor network availability（DATA）
information_points.content:
TELEM-DATA-624：Sensor diagnostics for the Granite Ridge Deep Shaft Complex verify that the deep core seismic sensor network online status is true for the triaxial downhole geophone array at candidate depth, with all pods actively acquiring synchronous data. Across a continuous 72 h downhole-to-surface telemetry stream, the borehole telemetry packet loss rate was 1.5 % on the high-temperature bus.
TELEM-DATA-12W：At the Pinon Basalt Horizon Laboratory, the deep core seismic sensor network online status is true, reflecting active synchronous data acquisition across all sensor pods in the triaxial downhole geophone array at candidate depth. Continuous downhole-to-surface telemetry monitoring over 72 h on the high-temperature bus recorded a borehole telemetry packet loss rate of 3.4 %.
TELEM-DATA-SWV：For the Caldron Caldera Subsurface Facility, the sensor diagnostic registry confirms that the deep core seismic sensor network online status is true for the triaxial downhole geophone array at candidate depth, with all seismic sensor pods reporting active synchronous data acquisition. In addition, the continuous downhole-to-surface digital telemetry stream over 72 h logged on the high-temperature bus indicates a borehole telemetry packet loss rate of 2.0 %.
